meta.title: Luminance Converter — Convert Candela/m² and More
meta.description: Free luminance converter for 7+ units including Candela/m², Candela/cm², Candela/ft². Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: cd/m², lambert, footlambert. Convert between 7 luminance units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for luminance in this tool is **cdm2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most luminance conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:

content.use_cases:
- Photography exposure planning across lumen and lux references.
- Workspace lighting design to meet ergonomic targets.
- Display brightness and ambient-light comparisons.
- Plant-grow lighting setups.
- Stage and event lighting design.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this luminance converter?
**A:** It uses 7 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Candela/m² (cd/m²), Candela/cm² (cd/cm²), Candela/ft² (cd/ft²), Lambert (L), Foot-lambert (fL), Nit (nt), Stilb (sb).
